items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I knew Don as a kid.

ctx.x: Don? I knew Don as a kid. Don and his girl friend used to come to the Howard Theatre when it wasn't fashionable. They would be sitting there. I'd make sure with all my boys at Seventh and T, I said, "These two kids are going to come in." They would be the only two. They'd let them come through the block and they'd be sitting there, come back stage, go and get those hot dogs and we'd go to Chicken Charlie's and what have you - those two kids... the only two white people that sat in the Howard Theatre was Don…
